The r7 authorization rule requires gate2 (status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- <path>) empty; an untracked artifact's own '?? <path>' line makes gate2 permanently unpassable, while the installed tool emits SAFE(stale) for the same file (fixture C; lore .scratch in r7).
